Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

necessary adjective

also necessarily, it is necessary, unnecessary, not necessary, essential, need to, needn’t, don’t need to, don’t have to, if it’s necessary for your health

classical

Cic. Fam. 14.20.1: cētera quae sunt ad vīctum et ad valētūdinem necessāria
Traupman 350

necessārius, necessāria, necessārium

adjective

necessary, indispensable

As a noun, necessārius is a relative or a close friend, someone bound to one by ties (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • 1Of what has to be, Latin says necesse est; dēbeō with an infinitive is for duty or obligation. Ruling: dēbeō is for duty.

    necesse est1 — it is necessary, one has to

    phrase: with an infinitive, an accusative and infinitive, or a subjunctive · classical · Hor. S. 2.6.26: īre necesse est; Publil. Q 75: quidquid plūs quam necesse est possideās, premit; Traupman 56: necesse est tibi manēre in lectō

  • opus est — there is need, it is needed

    phrase: what is needed in the ablative or as the subject · also used · classical · Quint. 6.3.66: nōn pluit, nōn opus est tibi; Sen. Ep. 80.4: quid tibi opus est ut sīs bonus?; Cic. Fam. 16.4.2: quod ad valētūdinem opus sit (Lewis & Short s.v. opus); Traupman 350

    Not necessary: nihil opus est (see require).

Examples

  • lābrum sī in balineō nōn est, ut sit, item cētera quae sunt ad vīctum et ad valētūdinem necessāria

    if there is no basin in the bath, see that there is one, and everything else necessary for food and healthCic. Fam. 14.20.1

  • sīve Aquilō rādit terrās seu brūma nivālem interiōre diem gȳrō trahit, īre necesse est

    whether the north wind is scouring the land or midwinter is dragging the snowy day round its shorter circle, I have to goHor. S. 2.6.25–26

  • nōn pluit, nōn opus est tibi; sī pluit, ipse ūtar

    if it isn’t raining, you don’t need it; if it is, I’ll wear it myselfQuint. 6.3.66

  • nec ultrā voluī legere nec opus erat

    I didn’t want to read any further, and there was no needAug. Conf. 8.12.29

  • Sī opus est ad valētūdinem …

    If it is necessary for your health …Traupman 104

  • Sī opus est tē commorārī …

    If it is necessary for you to stay on …Traupman 350

  • sī opus est ad tuam valētūdinem

    if it is necessary for your healthTraupman 350

See also require, basic, must.
